terms.gloss: a class or order of society
evidence: Cic. Dom. 74: proximus est huic dignitātī equester ōrdō (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: ōrdō senātōrius, the senatorial order; Traupman: ōrdō īnferior, the lower class, ōrdō medius, the middle class, ōrdō superior, the upper class.

terms.gloss: the knights, the Roman middle class

sources: Lewis & Short: ordo
Lewis & Short: eques
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 179, 180, each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
